recipes.name: Homemade Seitan - Mock Meat
instructions: Combine all the wet ingredients in a jar or small bowl. Set aside.
In a large bowl, mix together the remaining dry ingredients.
Add the wet mixture to the dry mixture and mix until it combines into a dough.
Knead the dough for 4 to 5 minutes.
Bring a pot of water to a boil and insert a steamer basket. Place the seitan in the middle of the basket and steam, covered, for 30 minutes.
Remove from the heat and allow to cool before using in your favourite recipes. Tear, shred, cut, or pulse in a food processor to make pieces of any size. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days. Freeze for up to 2 months.
